entities.name: Suzuki coupling of heteroaryl chloride
observations: The substrate Clc1ccc2ncccc2c1 is an aryl chloride electrophile, and the candidate partners are aryl boron reagents.
Both candidates encode the same aryl fragment but differ as a pinacol boronate ester versus potassium trifluoroborate.

entities.name: Aryl Bpin candidate
observations: This is an aryl pinacol boronate ester, a standard Suzuki coupling partner.

entities.name: Aryl BF3K candidate
observations: This is an aryl potassium trifluoroborate, an alternative Suzuki coupling partner.
Its use generally requires activation/hydrolysis of the trifluoroborate under suitable conditions.
